facts.fact: Daniel 把 CEO、Chief People Officer（CPO）和 Head of Inhuman Resources（Head of IR）三位高管叫到 Executive Suite 问话。
facts.anchor: the Agency’s Chief Executive Officer, Chief People Officer, and Head of Inhuman Resources are all waiting for me.

facts.fact: Head of IR 当场嗤笑，随即展开一卷羊皮纸大卷轴，Daniel 立刻认出那就是 The Reaper Handbook。
facts.anchor: The Head of IR scoffs, then begins unrolling a large parchment scroll I recognize immediately as The Reaper Handbook.

facts.fact: Head of IR 照卷宣读的第一条禁令是：禁止与人类灵魂做交易。
facts.anchor: “Bargains with human souls are forbidden,” he reads.

facts.fact: Daniel 在 Agency 的资历是 135 年 47 天，他当场纠正 CPO 说的「一百年」。
facts.anchor: “One hundred thirty-five,” I correct. And forty-seven days. Not like I’m counting.

facts.fact: CPO 早在 Daniel 到来之前就已在 Agency 干了几千年，她把他的资历视为「nothing」。
facts.anchor: My years with the Agency are nothing to her.

facts.fact: Daniel 提出的请求是让 Lucy McKenzie 复活，理由是她妹妹六周后结婚、她想出席婚礼。
facts.anchor: “Lucy McKenzie wishes to be brought back to life,” I confirm, wincing at how my voice wobbles. “Her sister is getting married in six weeks. She wants to be there for it.”

facts.fact: Agency 从不批准复活请求，因为做不到——生死只有一条单行道。
facts.anchor: We never grant them, because we can’t.

facts.fact: Death Cards 由 Executives 与 Powers That Be 制作，决定谁死、怎么死、何时死。
facts.anchor: I know this. The Executives—who, along with the Powers That Be, create the Death Cards that dictate who dies, how they die, and when—know I know this.

facts.fact: CEO 提议做 human reconnaissance，CPO 翻查厚皮活页夹后回答：上一次人类侦察是 1623 年。
Head of IR 代 Daniel 回答：他已连续五年未达配额，本周就要准备他的年度绩效考核。
facts.anchor: “It’s his fifth consecutive year of falling short,” the Head of IR answers for me. “I am preparing his annual performance evaluation this week.”

facts.fact: Executive 曾在 break room 加装弹球机与更多零食，想让 Daniel 恢复活力，但报告说毫无效果。
facts.anchor: We thought adding pinball machines and a wider variety of snacks to the break room might help restore your old vim and vigor.

facts.fact: Daniel 对自己的总结是「现在，显然，我是一颗棉花糖」——早上醒来时他还是厌倦死亡的意志消沉的 Reaper。
facts.anchor: Now, apparently, I am a marshmallow.

facts.fact: 他不能对高管说出真正原因，因为除了「不想放开她」，他自己也说不清理由。
facts.anchor: aside from not wanting to let her go.
